gui.guhs.snoes.verschijnt: Somebody is sitting next to your bed... a ruffled guh with a bent ear. He yawns, but he doesn't sleep. Talk to him.
gui.guhs.snoes.proloog.0: Njeg... hi. I'm Snoes. Sorry, I'm just sitting by your bed for a bit. It's so cosy here.
gui.guhs.snoes.proloog.1: Everybody has a little place to sleep. A basket, a nest, a box... Not me. I've never slept anywhere.
gui.guhs.snoes.geen_bedtijd: It's not bedtime yet, njeg. Come back tonight, then... maybe...
gui.guhs.snoes.ingestopt: Will you... tuck me in? Oh. Oh! It's soft. I'll close my eyes. But I won't sleep, you know.
gui.guhs.snoes.ingestopt_vloer: There's no box or basket here... but a little blanket on the floor is nice too. I'll close my eyes. But I won't sleep, you know.
gui.guhs.snoes.ga_slapen: Snoes is tucked in. Now go to sleep yourself, in your bed next to him. Maybe you can get into his dream...
gui.guhs.snoes.wakker_liggen: I'm lying here. Eyes open. Counting sheep doesn't help: I count guhs, and they all come for a cuddle.
gui.guhs.snoes.ander: Oh, hi! I'm waiting for somebody else, njeg. But you may pet me for a bit.
gui.guhs.snoes.thuis.0: You dream about me? Really? How many pieces do you have? %s of the five? Njeg...
gui.guhs.snoes.thuis.1: Last night I had my eyes closed for a moment. One second. Maybe two. (%s/5 pieces)
gui.guhs.snoes.thuis.2: Bubbels the Blub says you're searching well. A little longer, and then... then maybe I dare to sleep. (%s/5)
gui.guhs.snoes.droom.0: Is this my dream? It's so soft here. You already have %s pieces!
gui.guhs.snoes.droom.1: I can see the islands, but I don't dare go there. You do! (%s/5)
gui.guhs.snoes.droom.2: When all the pieces are here, maybe... maybe then I'll sleep. (%s/5)
gui.guhs.snoes.klaar: Snoes is asleep. He lives on the Dream Square now, in his box of nibbles, and he greets everybody who comes to dream. And the wild Blub-guhs show themselves to you now too!
gui.guhs.snoes.blij.0: %s! I slept again! In my box! Njeg njeg njeg!
gui.guhs.snoes.blij.1: Hi %s. The kitty house is very pretty, you know. I sit in it in the daytime. At night: box.
gui.guhs.snoes.blij.2: %s, do you know what I have now? A place. My very own place.
gui.guhs.snoes.blij.3: Welcome to the Dream Square, %s! Want a nibble? They're in my bed.
gui.guhs.snoes.blij.vreemde: Hi! I'm Snoes. I live here, in that box. Somebody helped me to sleep. Maybe you'll help somebody too?
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.welkom.0: Blub! Hi! I'm Bubbels, your dream guide. Welcome to Guh Dreamland!
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.welkom.1: Snoes can't dream. His dream blew over the islands in five pieces, blub.
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.welkom.2: A song, a star, a memory, a bath and dream sand. Find them, and we'll help him together!
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.welkom.3: Walk over a jetty to an island, in any order you like. I'll hop along!
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.terug: There you are again! Blub! We have %s of the five pieces.
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.stukje.liedje: The song! Now Snoes finally knows a lullaby. Blub-blub-bluuub! (%s/5)
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.stukje.ster: The falling star! He wishes for something... a place of his own. (%s/5)
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.stukje.herinnering: Now you know: he sat in the bushes, and watched. He belonged nowhere. Blub... (%s/5)
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.stukje.bad: His first bubble bath ever! Clean and warm. That makes you sleep well. (%s/5)
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.stukje.droomzand: Dream sand, freshly ground! A pinch, and your eyes grow heavy... (%s/5)
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.alles: All five! Blub blub blub! Come to the Dream Square quickly, everybody's coming to watch!
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.mee: May I... come home with you? I want to be your Blub. Blub?
gui.guhs.snoes.hud.bij_bed: Talk to Snoes by your bed.
gui.guhs.snoes.hud.ingestopt: Lie down in your bed next to Snoes and choose 'Dream together'.
gui.guhs.snoes.hud.zoek: Find the pieces on the islands (Dream Post takes you back quickly).
gui.guhs.snoes.hud.terug: Sleep next to Snoes to dream on.
gui.guhs.snoes.hud.finale: All found! Go to the Dream Square.
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.thuis_mee: Bubbels was still with you (on your head or in your pockets) and simply comes home with you. Blub!
gui.guhs.snoes.gids.thuis: Blub! So this is where you live. Nice! I'm staying. Forever.
gui.guhs.snoes.status.alles: Snoes' dream is complete! To the Dream Square!
gui.guhs.snoes.hint.zandguh.nog: The mill stands still, little vads. No wind, no dream sand. Maybe the Blubs can blow? They're good at bubbles.
gui.guhs.snoes.hint.zandguh.klaar: Snoes' dream sand is in a little bag with a bow. The finest sand I ever ground.
gui.guhs.snoes.hint.droom_omaguh.nog: Touch the memory bubbles, dear. The family day... I remember the bushes rustling.
gui.guhs.snoes.hint.droom_omaguh.klaar: I did see him, back then, in the bushes. I should have brought him a cookie. Now I do it every day.
gui.guhs.snoes.hint.rommelguh.nog: Memories? I've got plenty! Somewhere between the glasses. Have a look around Memory Island.
gui.guhs.snoes.hint.rommelguh.klaar: I saved a glass for Snoes. Not empty yet. Definitely.
gui.guhs.snoes.hint.kussengevecht_guh.no: Higher! Bounce higher! The star only falls when you're at the top. PILLOW!
gui.guhs.snoes.hint.kussengevecht_guh.kl: You have the star! We celebrate that with... PILLOW! Njeg!
gui.guhs.snoes.hint.wekkerguh: %s more pieces, then Snoes may sleep in. Until then: I only ring when you ask.
scene.guhs.snoesverhaal_finale.verteller: From every island they come to the Dream Square.
scene.guhs.snoesverhaal_finale.oma: There he is! I did see you, back then, in the bushes. Come here, dear. There are pink guh cakes.
scene.guhs.snoesverhaal_finale.rommel: I brought glasses! They're not empty yet.
scene.guhs.snoesverhaal_finale.verteller: You built a beautiful kitty house for Snoes.
...but Snoes crawls into the box of nibbles anyway.
scene.guhs.snoesverhaal_finale.lachen: Hahaha! Of course the box! A guh always picks the box! Njeg!
scene.guhs.snoesverhaal_finale.zand: A pinch of dream sand... sleep tight, little Snoes.
scene.guhs.snoesverhaal_finale.einde: Snoes is asleep. For the very first time.
